world.description: Get the nearest empty space with solid blocks beneath it of the given size.
world.returns: @returns {Vec3} - The south west corner position of the nearest free space.

world.description: Get a list of the nearest blocks of the given types.
world.returns: @returns {Block[]} - The nearest blocks of the given type.

world.description: Retrieves a list of all entities within a specified radius around the bot.
Finds the nearest entity that satisfies a given predicate within a specified maximum distance from the bot.
Retrieves a sorted list of nearby players within a specified distance from the bot, excluding the bot itself.
Returns an array of non-null item stacks from the bot's inventory.
Get an object representing the bot's inventory.
world.parameters: @param {Bot} bot - The bot to get the inventory for.
world.returns: @returns {object} - An object with item names as keys and counts as values.

world.description: Get your position in the world (Note that y is vertical). Use this typically when begining a build.
world.parameters: @param {Bot} bot - The bot to get the position for.
world.returns: @returns {Vec3} - An object with x, y, and x attributes representing the position of the bot.

world.description: Get a list of all nearby mob types.
world.parameters: @param {Bot} bot - The bot to get nearby mobs for.
world.returns: @returns {string[]} - A list of all nearby mobs.

world.description: Get a list of all nearby player names.
world.parameters: @param {Bot} bot - The bot to get nearby players for.
world.returns: @returns {string[]} - A list of all nearby players.

world.description: Get a list of all nearby block names.
world.parameters:
@param {Bot} bot - The bot to get nearby blocks for.
@param {number} distance - The maximum distance to search, default 16.
world.returns: @returns {string[]} - A list of all nearby blocks.

world.description: Check if there is a path to the target that requires no digging or placing blocks.
world.parameters:
@param {Bot} bot - The bot to get the path for.
@param {Entity} target - The target to path to.
world.returns: @returns {boolean} - True if there is a clear path, false otherwise.

world.description: Determines if a torch should be placed based on the bot's torch placing mode, nearby torches, and inventory.
Get the name of the biome the bot is in.
world.parameters: @param {Bot} bot - The bot to get the biome for.
